I could not recall the exact figure, so this is a best estimate. Disney's fiscal Q4 2024 ended September 28, 2024. Full-year fiscal 2024 net cash provided by operating activities was about $13.97 billion. Q4 is the full year minus the first nine months, and I put the nine-month figure at roughly $9.5–9.6 billion. That implies Q4 operating cash flow of about $4.4 billion.
